verdict.rationale: Paperspace's production API serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at https://api.paperspace.com/v1/openapi.json (61 paths), and the DigitalOcean-hosted API reference is generated from it. The generic-path probe 404s were on docs.digitalocean.com, a different host, so they do not contradict the spec's existence. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of using the spec, and documented discoverability of the spec URL from the docs (the unversioned path 404s).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json
The DigitalOcean-hosted Paperspace API reference is generated from it.
